title: Home screen — built: paper fan, colour in the icons
question: These are the built versions, not images: screenshots of the app running on this computer. Sectors are plain paper; each area's colour is in its icon only, like the moon of Day's end. Pick one, or steer.

options.label: Ivory paper
options.thesis: Ivory cotton paper, gold foil edge, coloured icons, Day's end as a sealed gold ring.
options.viewport: Serif greeting, the fan, Day's end seal with the video button inside, the write-anything bar, paper tab bar.
options.risk: The cards below the day (reminder, backup) are not restyled yet.

options.label: Blue paper
options.thesis: A dusty sage-blue sheet with ivory panels raised on it; coloured icons on the ivory.
options.viewport: Ivory greeting on blue, ivory fan and seal, ivory bar and tab.
options.risk: The most colour on screen; the icons compete a little more with the blue.
